title: Basic Breeding
description:
Breeding works a little differently in this pack. Animals have sexes, and instead of just feeding any two animals of the same type, you will need a breeding pair that is happy, comfortable, and well-fed. Happy animals will breed on their own.

Taking too long? You can use Fertility Potions (@todo check name) to increase the chances that a pregnancy will happen, and influence the quality of the babies born.
